subject: TAM coverage, shift rotations and incident ops — detailed responses
messages:
From: OliveBank SRE <sre@olivebank.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: TAM coverage details for RFP — questions

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for taking our RFP. We have a few detailed items in the "Support & Ops" section where we need explicit answers to include in our procurement packet:

1) Primary/secondary TAM coverage windows (including local daytime overlap with OliveBank EU ops).
2) Handoff process between shifts — what artifacts are produced and how long is the guaranteed acknowledgement window?
3) Pager escalation tiers and expected engineer response times for Severity 1/2 incidents.
4) On-call rotation model (follow-the-sun vs regional) and staffing ratios.
5) Evidence for auditability: audit logs, incident timelines, and SOC2 controls integration.

Can you provide a single consolidated document we can attach to the RFP? Attaching an example questionnaire below that shows the format our procurement team expects.

Att: olive_rfp_support_template.docx

Thanks,
Maya Richardson
Sr. Engineer, Production Reliability
OliveBank
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-20T10:08:00Z
Subject: Fwd: TAM coverage details for RFP — questions

Team — forwarding OliveBank's list. They want a single consolidated artifact for the procurement packet. I started a draft (attached) and sketched the operational commitments. Please review edits inline and add specifics where you own the detail. Key gaps I want covered:

- Exact S1/S2 ack and ETA commitments we can promise (ops vs eng).
- Handoff artifact list: what our TAM handoff includes (shift notes, open P1 list, KV cache warm/priming state notes).
- Pager escalation contact hierarchy with phone/Slack templates and expected timelines.
- Audit evidence references (SOC2 report location, log retention windows).

I'm aiming to send them a clean single PDF by 14:30 UTC today. Attaching: redwood_tam_shift_matrix_v1.xlsx and a draft incident_escalation_flow_v2.pdf.

--Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success (TAM Programs)
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-20T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: TAM coverage details for RFP — questions

Gatekeeping notes / suggested language for the doc:

- Coverage model: we recommend follow-the-sun primary TAM model with regional secondaries. Template: Primary TAM (08:00–18:00 local bank hours) + Secondary on-call (overnight) until next-day handoff. For OliveBank (US + EU presence) propose: US primary 14:00–02:00 UTC, EU primary 06:00–16:00 UTC, with 2-hour overlap windows for complex incidents.

- SLAs we can commit to (for RFP brief):
  * Severity 1: 15-minute acknowledgement, 60-minute engineering engagement (on-call engineer)
  * Severity 2: 60-minute acknowledgement, 4-hour remediation planning
  * Non-SEV: next-business-hour acknowledgement

- Handoff artifacts: completed end-of-shift summary (auto-generated checklist), active incident list (tickets + short notes), recent deployment summary (last 24h), KV cache prime state note when applicable. All artifacts stored in shared Drive folder and referenced in the handoff email.

- Escalation tiers (short):
  1) TAM -> Support Lead (within ack window)
  2) Support Lead -> On-call Engineer (if S1/S2)
  3) On-call Eng -> Infra Eng (if kernel/hardware)
  4) Exec on-call (for customer-impacting >4h outages)

I'll annotate the attached XLS with staffing ratios per region.

-ben

Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-20T12:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: TAM coverage details for RFP — questions

Quick legal/ops clarifications to include in the deliverable:

- We can state the operational commitments above as "Targeted response windows" with explicit exceptions for force majeure and scheduled maintenance. Avoid absolute "guarantees" in the RFP response unless the customer signs a Dedicated SLA amendment.

- Audit evidence: point them to the SOC2 Type II report stored on the compliance portal (link included), and specify log retention windows by class: 1 year (audit trail), 90 days (detailed request logs), 30 days (live runtime traces). Confirm we can provide certified extracts for procurement review under NDA.

- Attach a short paragraph about telemetry we can share post-onboarding: token-level latency histogram, per-route error rates, and sample incident timelines.

I'll draft the exception clause and sign-off language.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations (Contracts)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Maya Richardson <maya.richardson@olivebank.com>, OliveBank SRE <sre@olivebank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-20T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: TAM coverage details for RFP — questions

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a consolidated PDF that answers each item in your template and includes our proposed staffing matrix, the escalation flow, and a short note on audit evidence. Key excerpts below for quick inclusion in your packet: 

- Coverage model: follow-the-sun with regional primaries. Proposed windows maintain a 2-hour overlap for cross-region incident handoffs.

- Response commitments (targeted): S1 ack within 15 minutes; S1 engineering engagement within 60 minutes. S2 ack within 60 minutes; remediation planning by 4 hours. All commitments are "targeted" operating windows; dedicated SLA language available as a commercial addendum for Reserved/Dedicated customers.

- Handoff artifacts: auto-generated end-of-shift checklist, open incident list, last-24h deployment digest, KV cache state note (if applicable). Stored in shared Drive accessible to your SREs once onboarding is complete.

- Escalation: TAM -> Support Lead -> On-call Eng -> Infra Eng -> Exec on-call (for >4h P1). We included phone and Slack templates in the attachment.

- Audit evidence: SOC2 Type II report link included, plus retention windows (1y audit logs, 90d request logs, 30d runtime traces). We can provide extracts under NDA.

Attachments: redwood_tam_shift_matrix_v1.xlsx, incident_escalation_flow_v2.pdf (drive links inside the PDF).

Can you confirm that this level of detail satisfies the procurement format? If you'd like a short one-page summary instead, I can produce that by EOD.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success (TAM Programs)
Redwood Inference
